newlib and libgcc (Arm GNU Toolchain 14.2.Rel1)
===============================================

Used in:    all tag firmware images
Source:     https://developer.arm.com/downloads/-/arm-gnu-toolchain-downloads
            (newlib: https://sourceware.org/newlib/)

The images link only these parts of the toolchain's C library (newlib), as the
link maps of the distributed tags show:

  memcpy             newlib/libc/machine/arm/memcpy-armv7m.S   ARM Ltd, BSD-3-Clause
  memset, memmove,   newlib/libc/string/*.c                    newlib default notice
  strncpy                                                       (COPYING.NEWLIB, part 1)

and integer and floating-point helper routines from libgcc, which is licensed
under GPL-3.0 with the GCC Runtime Library Exception. The exception places no
conditions on the firmware.

newlib, COPYING.NEWLIB part 1 (applies to memset.c, memmove.c, strncpy.c,
which carry no notice of their own):
